title: IST – SOLL – GAP (as-is – target – gap)
summary: A model for the structured identification of deviations between the existing and the desired situation.

text: The model helps to structure complex problems first, before specific measures are developed.
Where are we today – where do we want to go – and what is preventing us from reaching the goal?
The model can be used for organisational, economic and administrative questions.
A process takes considerably longer than planned.
items: Target: the process should be completed within 7 days.
beispiel.note: The next step is not to decide on a solution straight away, but to examine why this difference arises.

text: The problem turns from a general perception into a structured question.
The model does not replace a specialist legal review or a detailed specialist analysis where a question requires particular legal or technical expertise.
